en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a wide, tree-lined avenue (allee) with neatly trimmed tall trees on both sides, creating a symmetrical and formal garden view. The foreground has a rope or chain barrier and a signpost. The words 'Bad Pyrmont. Bornbergallee.' are printed at the bottom. The back contains handwritten German text, an address, and a postage stamp from the Deutsches Reich. It also features the logo and text of 'Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'.
